references.text: Also in Matthew 10:22 we find a similar thought about endurance and salvation, which underscores the importance of standing firm to the end.
James 1:12 also speaks of the blessing for the one who endures trials, which resonates with the idea of perseverance in Matthew 24:13.
In Revelation 2:10 there is an exhortation to be faithful until death to receive the crown of life, which reflects the message about endurance in Matthew 24:13.
Although Isaiah 40:31 does not directly mention perseverance or salvation, it speaks of the strength that comes from waiting on the Lord, which can be seen in connection with the theme of endurance.
